text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon has a quiz coming up soon, so I decide to bring her to the library for some studying.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You know, my grades aren't so bad that you need to be here to watch me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, I suppose it isn't rare to be at the bottom of your class when you don't sit for tests to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But at least I show up for the important ones. See, there's no problem.
choice_data_list: You have to take the quizzes too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No I don't. I understand how learning enriches one's life, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's precisely why academics should be recognized as a hobby.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Besides, I have better things to do than to take tests.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… I'll have you know, I just finished a new concoction this morning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Drinking it activates the brain's neurons, making you instantly aware of every phenomenon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I listen to her explanation of what I'm sure is just another dangerous drug of hers… but to my surprise, she's taken it herself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, if successful, my neurons should be more than ten times as sharp for at least half the day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, I've also predicted that certain cases may result in the occurrence of symptoms like fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I know, right? My mind is sharp as a knife!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But, unfortunately, "sharp" seems to be the extent of this benefit. I haven't reached my original estimate of ten times the clarity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, it did take a tremendous amount of effort and time to make it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Maybe it's best I don't continue this experiment for some time…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a big sigh of resignation, Agnes Tachyon leaves the library.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Incidentally, she earns a perfect score on her quiz.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, I've also predicted that certain cases may result in the occurrence of symptoms like fatigue.
choice_data_list: Does your body feel any different?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm extremely tired right now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But at the same time, my head feels strangely clear… It's a curious sensation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't call this experiment a perfect success, but these results aren't bad either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her exhausted appearance contrasts with her tone of voice. With that, she decides to leave the library.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Incidentally, she earns a perfect score on her quiz.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And so! My mind is sharp as a knife at the moment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Despite my subjective conclusion, I feel the effect has improved my perception at least ten times over!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Indeed, there's nothing better than a successful experiment! It's exhilarating! Totally worth the trouble!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now to continue further testing and obtain more data. Heh-heh-heh!
choice_data_list: What about studying for the quiz?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa. When did I ever say anything about studying?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I just followed you to the library to get a walk in to stimulate the brain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And with that said, toodle-oo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon exits the library with a spring in her step, leaving me no chance to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Incidentally, I manage to have her take the quiz, and somehow she gets a perfect score.
